thread:
kai: Support reported a double-charge when a streaming toolcall was resumed after truncation + node failover. Repro attached.

emma: Quick summary: we write provisional rows on chunk commit, but stitching relies on a node-local pointer. If the pointer is lost (eviction or canary swap) another node can create a second provisional/confirm.

raj: Short-term mitigation: global small-index in redis keyed by (acct, toolcall_id || prefix_hash). Use SETNX so the first provisional wins. If SETNX fails, link to existing id and avoid emitting a new provisional ledger row. TTL ~120s.

kai: Console needs: a debug toggle to include provisional rows and a per-customer "prov_vs_conf_delta" alert. Support should see linked IDs when investigating.

billing-bot: note: billing aggregation will need to dedupe by canonical_prov_id or prefer earliest confirm. Creating ticket BT-478.

emma: Edge-case: if canonical never confirms before TTL expires we could still double-charge later. We'll tune TTL to cover typical resume windows and add a reconciliation job to collapse orphan provisionals.

raj: I'll prototype SETNX and add a `canonical_id` field to provisional rows. Kai, can you mock the console panel?

kai: On it. Filing infra jira for redis index and ledger schema change.

emma: Also add a router trace header `X-Resume-Prov` so new routes can carry the provisional id when present.

raj: Agreed. Minimal perf impact expected; will bench p50/p99.

kai: Thanks — assigning owners in the ticket. :thumbsup:
